text: Mr. Maclane drove 577.2 miles. Ms. Lopez drove 165.4 miles. About how many more miles did Mr. Maclane drive than Ms. Lopez? A) 400 miles B) 300 miles C) 800 miles D) 700 miles

The table shows the weights in tons of four cars: Q=1.269, R=1.314, S=1.281, T=1.238. Which statement is true? A) weight of S < weight of T B) weight of Q > weight of R C) weight of R < weight of T D) weight of S > weight of Q
A restaurant bill was paid equally by 7 friends. The bill was $99.96. How much money in dollars and cents did each person pay? (griddable numeric answer)

Kassidy charges $8.50 for a dog bathed and walked, $5.75 for walked only. Saturday: 6 walks only, Sunday: 5 walks only, Saturday: 4 bathed+walked, Sunday: 4 bathed+walked. Expression: 5.75(6+5) + 8.50(2x4). How much did she earn? A) $97.25 B) $1,411.00 C) $194.50 D) $131.25
A baker had 48 cups of flour. Used 11 1/4 cups Friday and 14 1/2 cups Saturday. How many cups were left? F) 22 1/4 G) 23 3/4 H) 25 3/4 J) 23 1/4
A man bought 6 cans of tuna. Each can cost $0.93. What is the total amount spent? F) $4.98 G) $5.58 H) $6.93 J) $5.48

Carmella plotted the ordered pair (1, 3) on a coordinate grid by moving 1 unit up and 3 units left from the origin. Which statement is true? F) both coordinates plotted incorrectly G) x incorrect, y correct H) x correct, y incorrect J) both correct
What is the value of this expression: 1/5 ÷ 30? A) 1/150 B) 1/6 C) 6 D) 150
skill: dividing a fraction by a whole number

text: A basketball team: 6 baskets worth 3 points each, 21 baskets worth 2 points each, 16 points from 1-point baskets. p = 6(3) + 21(2) + 16. What is the total? F) 76 G) 48 H) 94 J) 60

Table: students joining vs total at table. Mon: 3 joined, 8 total. Tue: 2 joined, 7 total. Wed: 8 joined, 13 total. Thu: 5 joined, 10 total. What relationship type exists? A) additive, add 5 B) multiplicative, total>joining C) additive, joining<total D) multiplicative, multiply by 5
skill: identifying additive vs multiplicative relationships in a table

text: Completion times (min): Mario 12.068, Rosa 11.450, Chris 12.495, Jessica 11.50, Nellie 12.085. Ordered least to greatest, what position is Nellie's time? A) Second B) Third C) Fourth D) Fifth

Which answer choice best describes the x-coordinate in an ordered pair? F) horizontal line of points with y=0 G) first number, determines left/right movement from origin H) second number, determines up/down movement J) intersection of two lines
Tickets for a school event sold for $18 each. Total collected: $4,554. How many tickets were sold? A) 253 B) 254 C) 268 D) 230

Three cities form a triangle. Distances: Chapel Hill to Durham = 10.1 mi, Durham to Raleigh = 21.5 mi, Raleigh to Chapel Hill = 28.1 mi. What is the perimeter of the triangle in miles? (griddable numeric answer)
skill: perimeter as sum of decimal lengths

text: What is the value of this expression: 3(25 + 19) + 4(3)? A) 294 B) 144 C) 408 D) 168
A family used 2.24 pounds of ground beef to make 8 equal-size hamburgers. How much ground beef in pounds was used for each hamburger? A) 0.33 lb B) 0.28 lb C) 0.3 lb D) 2.8 lb

Penelope earns $450/month. May expenses: Cell phone $50, Clothing $100, Entertainment $150, Food $120, Savings $50 (total $470, over budget by $20). Which change balances her budget? F) increase savings by $20 G) decrease entertainment by $20 H) increase food by $10 J) decrease clothing by $10
skill: budgeting/reasoning with a table of amounts

text: A large piece of paper is 91.44 cm from top to bottom. Two strips were cut: 25.4 cm and 15.24 cm. What is the length in cm of the remaining part? A) 73.66 cm B) 61.2 cm C) 40.64 cm D) 50.8 cm
What is 2.938 rounded to the nearest hundredth? (griddable numeric answer)
Lee Ann bought 2 cartons of yogurt. She ate 1/8 of a carton each day. How many days did it take her to eat all the yogurt in the 2 cartons? A) 10 B) 16 C) 4 D) 6
skill: dividing whole number by unit fraction

text: Stem-and-leaf plot of laps walked: stem 3, leaves 1 2 2 2 3 (31,32,32,32,33); stem 4, leaves 1 6 (41,46); stem 5, leaves 0 3 (50,53); stem 6, leaves 3 3 5 (63,63,65). Teams that walked more than 50 laps raised an extra $100. What fraction of the teams raised this money? F) 1/4 G) 5/12 H) 5/7 J) 1/3
skill: reading a stem-and-leaf plot, computing a fraction

text: A car rental business had 45 cars Monday morning. Rented 3 cars/hour for 5 hours, then 2 cars/hour for 3 hours. 17 cars were returned. Which equation gives c, the number of cars at end of day? A) c=45-(5+3)-(3+2)+17 B) c=45-(5x3)-(3x2)-17 C) c=45-(5+3)-(3+2)-17 D) c=45-(5x3)-(3x2)+17
skill: translating a word problem into an equation

text: Which operation should be performed first when simplifying: 40 ÷ (5 + 3) × 8 + 1? A) 40÷5, left to right B) 5+3, parentheses first C) 3x8, multiplication before addition D) 8+1, right to left

Jacqueline works 5 days a week. She spends 1/3 of each day at work. Which expression gives the number of days she works each week (interpreting from a model of 5 days each 1/3 shaded)? F) 5 + 1/2 G) 5 + 1/3 H) 5 x 1/2 J) 5 x 1/3
skill: recognizing repeated addition as multiplication with a fraction
